    mov rsp, [gs:0x0]

    push qword 0x1b ; user data
    push qword [gs:0x8] ; saved stack

    push qword 0x23 ; user code

    push_all

   ; exit  : success
   ;

   ;            carry reset

   ;

   call am48_dsub
